latest_release.body: ## Active Support * `ActiveSupport::MessagePack` no longer deserializes an unsafe `ActiveSupport::SafeBuffer` as `html_safe`. A `SafeBuffer` that was no longer `html_safe?`, for example after an in-place `gsub!`, was deserialized as an `html_safe` `SafeBuffer`. It is now serialized with an unsafe marker and deserialized as a `String`. Earlier versions of Rails cannot read an unsafe buffer serialized this way. [GHSA-2w9f-fxwj-w2qf] *Jean Boussier* * `ActiveSupport::Inflector#safe_constantize` matches the constant name in a `LoadError` message as a literal string instead of building a `Regexp` from it. The name's segments were interpolated unescaped into the pattern, so input that reaches `safe_constantize`, such as the channel identifier in an Action Cable subscribe command, chose the source passed to the regexp compiler. [GHSA-8474-xrp6-wh69] *Jeremy Daer* ## Active Model * No changes. ## Active Record * No changes. ## Action View * Skip attribute names in tag helpers that are blank once converted to a string. A Symbol such as `:" "` is not blank, because `Symbol#blank?` is `Symbol#empty?`, so it reached the escaping step and produced an attribute with no name. The asset helpers symbolize their keys, so an ordinary String key reached the same place. [GHSA-68p9-83h6-5wpj] *Mike Dalessio* * Fix `strip_tags` to encode `"` and `'` in its output. `strip_tags` returns an `html_safe` string, but was not encoding quotation marks. The method now encodes all five HTML-significant characters (`&`, `<`, `>`, `"`, `'`), consistent with the existing `html_safe` convention. Output used outside HTML, such as in a text template or JSON, now contains `"` and `'` where it contained `"` and `'`. `CGI.unescapeHTML` decodes them. [GHSA-rq8q-p985-fjq7] *Mike Dalessio* * Escape the matched phrase before substituting it into `highlight`'s `:highlighter`. A match was copied into each `\1` of the highlighter as it appeared in the sanitized text, which keeps `"` and `'` as they are, so a match containing a quote ended a quoted attribute value such as the documented `'\1'` and added attributes of its own. Each substituted group now goes through `ERB::Util.html_escape_once`, so quotes in a match render as `"` and `'`. Only the numbered placeholders `\0` to `\9` are expanded, and a match never replaces the `>` that closes a tag. [GHSA-v6rj-xm57-3p59] *Jeremy Daer* * Require rails-html-sanitizer 1.7.2 or later. With the HTML5 sanitizer, Nokogiri before 1.19.5 left `<` and `>` unescaped in attribute values. `highlight` and `simple_format`, which edit the sanitized HTML as a string, could then turn markup inside an attribute value into live elements. rails-html-sanitizer 1.7.2 requires Loofah 2.25.3, which requires Nokogiri 1.19.5. [GHSA-2p2f-4rq4-gjwc] *Mike Dalessio* ## Action Pack * Apply `config.action_dispatch.cookies_same_site_protection` to every session store. `ActionDispatch::Session::CacheStore`, `MemCacheStore` and third-party stores built on `AbstractStore` or the session mixins sent session cookies with no `SameSite` attribute. Only `CookieStore` applied the configured default. [GHSA-gmj8-hvj3-49mw] *Jean Boussier* * Prevent `ActionController::Live` streams from blocking when a full buffer is closed or aborted. [GHSA-rwvh-fw6r-pwvp] *Jeremy Daer* * Set and extend the `Vary` header for rendered responses according to the request headers used in format negotiation. `Vary: Accept` was only added when the request carried a usable `Accept` header.
